title: Workspace bootstrap and inherited Grapher adoption

content.result: Dreadnought initialization captures human bootstrap intent, selects or discovers a managed project root, generates a ready bootstrap Mission and durable instructions, adopts existing schema-v2 Grapher brains without rewriting historical nodes, routes control-plane Grapher access from a workspace root to a nested managed project, and exposes the bootstrap contract consistently through top-level CLI help.
content.interpretation: A fresh workspace containing an older Grapher-backed project can be brought under Dreadnought without Agent Hub, without destructive Grapher reinitialization, and without requiring the operator to hand-author project instructions before bootstrap. The inherited truth-status allowlist uses Grapher's node-ID contract.
